Name: Post Wedding Dates
Author: Blams
Description:
Work in progress
(All translations for this mod are allowed, go crazy)

[i]Translations
[/i]- English (me)
- French (me)
- Portuguese ([url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194115900-lottievalley/]LottieValley[/url])
- Chinese ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/yuquansun]yuquansun[/url])



[b][size=4][u]What am I working on?

[/u][/size][/b]- Adding spouse specific reactions for the Saloon date sequence
- Wedding anniversary

[b][u][size=4]Dialogue additions

[/size][/u][size=3]Wedding Anniversary
[/size][/b]Your spouse will have new dialogue on the day of your anniversay. The dialogue is different depending on your relationship level.
(Note: Will not work if spouse is in their spouse room. I haven't figured out how to make that work [i]yet. [/i]Dialogue is added for the day. Example spring_11. So special dialogue will override it.)

[b][size=4][u]General Cutscenes[/u][/size][/b]

[size=3][b]Bathhouse
[/b][/size](See Video for the cutscene itself)

Every day if you enter the pool area of the bathhouse you'll get the same short cutscene with your spouse.
[i]Default configuration:[/i]
[i]﻿8pm - 12am[/i]
[i]﻿Fall, winter
﻿Monday, friday, saturday
﻿25%[/i]

[b][size=3]Summit[/size]
[/b](See Video for the cutscene itself)

Every day if you enter the summit you'll get the same short cutscene with your spouse.
[i]Default configuration:[/i]
[i]﻿12pm - 8pm[/i]
[i]﻿Spring, summer, fall
﻿Monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
﻿25%[/i]

[b][size=3]Forest Picnic[/size]
[/b](See Video for the cutscene itself)

Every sunny day before 5pm, if you enter the forest you'll get the same short cutscene with your spouse.
[i]Default configuration:[/i]
[i]﻿Spring, summer, fall[/i]
[i] ﻿Monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday[/i]
[i] ﻿4%[/i]

[size=3][b]Ice Skating[/b][/size]
(See Video for the cutscene itself) (Custom map was added for this cutscene)

Every sunny day before 5pm, if you enter the forest during winter you'll get the same short cutscene with your spouse.
[i]Default configuration:[/i]
[i] ﻿Winter
﻿Monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
﻿4%[/i]

[b][size=3]Farmhouse (House has to have been upgraded twice)[/size]
[/b](See Video for the cutscene itself) (Custom quest was added for this cutscene)

Every morning when you wake up or enter your house in the morning, your spouse has a chance to ask you on a date to the Saloon.
[i]Default configuration:[/i]
[i]﻿Spring, summer, fall, winter
﻿Friday, saturday
﻿5%


[/i]-------------------------------------------------

[b]Compatible with all spouses - including mod added spouses[/b]
